caveats: Three civilian women (Mason, Brannan, Hemberger) sued City of Warren, Chief Erik Merkel, and ex-officer Michael Edwards Jr. in N.D. Ohio, filed March 2025. Marked ongoing: defendants answered denying liability May 2025 with jury trial demanded, and accessible source headlines (appeals ruling lifting stay; case could stretch into next year, 2026 coverage) indicate active litigation; no resolution or settlement in any readable source. Three of seven sources were inaccessible (WKBN 403s, WFMJ 429). Edwards convicted Sept 2024 (rape, sexual battery, GSI, extortion, theft in office), sentenced 34-39 years; convictions and sentence affirmed on appeal April 2026 and Ohio Supreme Court declined review.
